title: Decision
description: A choice point a Role makes during mission execution, given specific information inputs (informedBy) and criteria — a finer grain than DoctrineProcess (organizational tasking) or Interaction (a structural edge): what a person actually has to decide, not just who they talk to. See ARCHITECTURE.md Section 6.

roleId.description: The Role that makes this decision.

informedBy.description: The nodes (roles, systems, etc.) whose information feeds this decision.

criteria.description: What determines the outcome — the standard the Role applies.
